{{Quote|&hellip;the benevolent guidance of the Emperor has once again saved his subjects from harm. The Imperial medical service has ended the terrible plague on Sedesia...|Imperial news release on Sedesia|<ref name="TC" />}}
The '''Sedesia task force''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] detachment composed of various Imperial branches sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]] to deal with an outbreak of the "[[FNV-23|Gray Death]]," a highly deadly plague. It was part of the [[Pathogen-Based Loyalty Enhancement Program]], led by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Fesjo Negleem]].<ref name="TC" />

==Composition==
===COMPNOR===
The largest part of the task force was the detachment of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. The [[Coalition for Improvements#Redesign|Redesign Bureau]] of the [[Coalition for Improvements/Legends|Coalition for Improvements]] sent a large medical group to conduct on-site research on the plague, led by Dr. Fesjo Negleem.<ref name="TC" />

The [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|SAGroup]] sent many volunteers to distribute the antivirus among the population. These volunteers operated so-called health-stations and carried [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], [[Computer/Legends|hand computers]] and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TC" />

To provide security, a [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] regiment was sent along as well. This regiment was composed of an assault [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] and two [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] battalions. The extreme climate of Sedesia made the use of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] units impossible, so the fourth battalion, a repulsorlift was outfitted with 88 [[Swift Assault 5|hoverscouts]] and an assortment of 22 [[wheel bike]]s. Of the usual total complement of 3,380 troopers, 2,560 men were sent to Sedesia.<ref name="TC" />

===Imperial Navy===
The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] sent four ships to Sedesia: one [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]], one [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] and two [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]]. The Dreadnaught and the Strike cruiser each carried a single [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. This was an extremely small force for a planetary occupation, since these squadrons would usually include at least a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. However, since there was hardly any resistance and most ships avoided the planet because of the plague, these four ships proved to be enough to maintain a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]].<ref name="TC" />

===Imperial Army===
The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] sent 3,000 regular [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Army troopers]],<ref name="TC" /> roughly [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] strength.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> They were stationed on board the ''Dreadnaught''-class cruiser.<ref name="TC" />

===Stormtrooper Corps===
The [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] sent a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], together with an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] and two [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], all stationed aboard the Strike cruiser.<ref name="TC" />

==Deployment history==
{{Quote|Good afternoon citizens - is it time for your booster immunizations?|SAGroup volunteer|<ref name="TC" />}}
The planet of Sedesia, which had been a hotbed of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers, had suddenly been hit by a terrible plague that quickly spread among the population. Over ninety-nine percent got infected with the Gray Death within the first two weeks, and over 35,000 people lost their lives. Government, military and Rebel resistance ceased to function. As part of the Pathogen-Based Loyalty Enhancement Program, the Empire formed the Sedesia task force and moved in to help the planet.<ref name="TC" />

The starships were deployed along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|spacelanes]] around the planet, establishing a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and enforcing the [[quarantine]]. The plague had already disrupted the government and military of Sedesia, so when the Empire arrived, the CompForce Regiment was enough to ensure a bloodless occupation. For the following months, the CompForce regiment remained the only military presence on the planet. [[Company/Legends|Company]]-sized units were deployed in the most important cities on the planet, with the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Besia Osurne]] becoming the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] headquarters. Stationed there were four companies, a Heavy Weapons Company armed with light repeating blasters, an infantry, a wheelbike and a hoverscout company.<ref name="TC" />

Shorty after the establishment of the quarantine, almost all remaining ships had left the planet, and regular merchant ships avoided the plague-infested planet. The medical unit had set up headquarters in an old [[Imperial Research Center (Sedesia)|veterinary medicine center]] outside the capital to search for a [[FNA-23-B|cure]]. Volunteers from the SAGroup then began distributing the antiviral shots among the population from so-called health stations set up in the streets of nearly every neighborhood. Most of the Rebel sympathizers on the planet didn't trust the Empire and refused to take the cure, and they died shortly after the outbreak. Although the garrison [[Commander/Legends|commander]] could summon help from the troops in orbit in case of trouble, there was no need to do so. The rest of the population welcomed the Empire and accepted their help.<ref name="TC" />

Due to the outbreak of the plague, the rest of the galaxy avoided the planet. For the following six months, the ships and troops in orbit remained idle. This changed when the Rebel Alliance noted the situation on the planet. Doctor [[Andros Hareel]] of the Rebellion's medical section sent a [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends#Special Ops Teams|team]] to [[Mission to Sedesia|infiltrate]] Sedesia. The [[Agent/Legends|agents]] attacked the research center and delivered the data about the Pathogen-Based Loyalty Enhancement Program and [[FNA-23-B]] to the population.<ref name="TC" />

After discovering the truth behind the Gray Death, the mob of Sedesia filled the streets and revolted against the Imperial forces. Although CompForce and SAGroup personnel had better weapons, they were spread thin, outnumbered and disorganized in the initial moments of the uprising. However, as the Imperials realized that Dr. Negleem's project had failed, another task force arrived and quickly took over the planet by force. The Rebel agents continued to fight the Imperials, formed a resistance and conducted guerrilla operations. Dr. Negleem escaped the situation on Sedesia and continued his work on several other planets.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This task force was introduced in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[The Cure]]'', first published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 6]]. It detailed the task force's composition and deployment, but gave no name for this unit.
